entities.name: Alfred I, Prince of Windisch-Grätz
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: General Alfred Candidus Ferdinand, Prince of Windischgrätz, a member of an old Austro-Bohemian House of Windischgrätz, was a Field Marshal in the Austrian army. He is most noted for his service during the Napoleonic Wars and for his role in suppressing the Revolutions of 1848 in the Austrian Empire.

entities.summary: General Alfred Candidus Ferdinand, Prince of Windischgrätz, a member of an old Austro-Bohemian House of Windischgrätz, was a Field Marshal in the Austrian army. He is most noted for his service during the Napoleonic Wars and for his role in suppressing the Revolutions of 1848 in the Austrian Empire.
